name.zh: 九一八事变后侵占东北
name.en: Occupation of the Northeast after the Mukden Incident

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：自沈阳沿铁路北犯，1932 年 2 月占领哈尔滨。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: advance north along the railway from Shenyang, occupying Harbin in February 1932.

name.zh: 全面侵华：平津—淞沪—南京

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：自卢沟桥事变后南下，经平津、淞沪进攻南京。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: advance south after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, through Beiping–Tianjin and Shanghai to Nanjing.

name.en: Advance along the Yangtze and into South China

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：1938 年日军沿长江进攻武汉，并于 10 月 21 日占领广州。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: Japanese forces advanced up the Yangtze toward Wuhan in 1938 and took Guangzhou on 21 October.

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：1944 年日军发动豫湘桂战役，自河南沿湘桂铁路南犯至南宁。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: the 1944 Ichi-Go offensive pushed south from Henan along the Hunan–Guangxi railway to Nanning.
